blocks.title: Support Summary: Union Raffle (GAME_UK_04)
blocks.text:
Support Summary: Union Raffle (GAME_UK_04) (MKT_UK, en)
This document covers Union Raffle (GAME_UK_04). The game belongs to the Fixed Prize Raffle product family. The core game mechanic is: Losing entries go into a second draw (MECH_UK_SECOND_CHANCE). The campaign New Season Start UK (CMP_001) promoted the game during the period. Customer contacts were monitored through the usual support channels. Figures in this document are taken from the central reporting warehouse. Responsible gaming obligations were checked with the compliance lead. No further action is required for this reporting period.

blocks.title: Campaign Evaluation: New Season Start UK (CMP_001)
blocks.text:
Campaign Evaluation: New Season Start UK (CMP_001) (MKT_UK, en)
Scope of this document: New Season Start UK (CMP_001). Risks were reviewed with the finance and legal stakeholders. Figures in this document are taken from the central reporting warehouse. The campaign promoted Lioness Instant (GAME_UK_05) to active and lapsed players. Retail and digital sales were compared week by week across the period. Feedback from retailers was collected during the regular field visits. No further action is required for this reporting period.

blocks.title: Marketing Brief: Twin Ticket Trail GR (CMP_006)
blocks.text:
Marketing Brief: Twin Ticket Trail GR (CMP_006) (MKT_GR, en)
This document covers Twin Ticket Trail GR (CMP_006). Retail and digital sales were compared week by week across the period. Stakeholders agreed to revisit Twin Ticket Trail GR (CMP_006) at the next monthly review. Feedback from retailers was collected during the regular field visits. The campaign promoted Peloponnesus Pull (GAME_GR_05) to active and lapsed players. Open actions are tracked in the shared operations log. Campaign spend stayed within the approved budget. The next review is scheduled with the market operations team.

blocks.title: Campaign Evaluation: Instant Cross-Sell Push UK (CMP_017)
blocks.text:
Campaign Evaluation: Instant Cross-Sell Push UK (CMP_017) (MKT_UK, en)
The campaign Instant Cross-Sell Push UK promoted Lioness Instant (Scratchcard) to the Engaged segment from 2025-04-11 to 2025-05-21. 70 percent of exposed players engaged with the campaign. 46 percent of engaged players went on to buy Lioness Instant. The result is well above our usual campaign response and the approach is worth repeating.

This document covers Union Raffle (GAME_UK_04). The game belongs to the Fixed Prize Raffle product family. The core game mechanic is: Losing entries go into a second draw (MECH_UK_SECOND_CHANCE). The campaign New Season Start UK (CMP_001) promoted the game during the period. Customer contacts were monitored through the usual support channels. Figures in this document are taken from the central reporting warehouse. Responsible gaming obligations were checked with the compliance lead. The campaign Instant Cross-Sell Push UK promoted Lioness Instant (Scratchcard) to the Engaged segment from 2025-04-11 to 2025-05-21. 70 percent of exposed players engaged with the campaign. 46 percent of engaged players went on to buy Lioness Instant. The result is well above our usual campaign response and the approach is worth repeating.

A.verdict: Albion Millions, Thames Cash, SwiftSix, Vltava Výhra, Rychle Cisla, Stastny Kupon
A.answer: The games affected by incidents on platform version PLV_RETAIL_2 (2024.2.0) include Albion Millions, Thames Cash, and SwiftSix from incident INC_033 [1], as well as Vltava Výhra, Rychle Cisla, and Stastny Kupon from incident INC_036 [2]. Incident INC_035 also occurred on this platform version but affected Edelweiss Instant; however, the source for INC_035 lists platform version PLV_RETAIL_1 (2024.1.0) [4], so it is excluded. Therefore, the affected games are Albion Millions, Thames Cash, SwiftSix, Vltava Výhra, Rychle Cisla, and Stastny Kupon.
